rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or above it, or the printed item number on its row. Items 1, 3, 4, 13 and 21 options take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option). Name and address continuation lines join under the item 8/9 captions. Item 7 RDO takes drpPg1Pt1I7RDOCode (txtRDO holds the same code, one cell only). Part II/IV and Schedule III/V amounts are 12-slot pesos-only combs with no centavo comb, so no money_joins pair exists and they stay blank. Schedule II rows and Schedule IIIA rows have no printed item numbers and stay blank. Item 2 Year Ended and Item 10 date stay blank (single boxes or three-comb dates under one key). Stamped TIN combs (name=) take no join.
